summary: QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to furnish a press release announcing first-quarter 2026 financial results. The release reports revenue of $6.5 million, a 133% year-over-year increase, and notes the extension of a senior secured term loan maturity to March 2029 and a new CPT code for US reimbursement. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure with no M&A, activist, or restructuring event. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes are present. The filing is purely operational and financial, not a special situation.
